name: Ryu Martial Artist

entries.name: Ryū-dera Training
entries.text: As a bonus action, you can make a punch or kick attack.

entries.name: Ryūken Stance
entries.text: You can mark a creature as a reaction. The marked creature remains marked for 1 minute or until another creature is marked. A marked creature suffers a 1d4 penalty to its AC when you would target it with unarmed attacks until the end of the current turn.

entries.name: Ryū Aura
entries.text: Your Ryu Hijutsu use Strength instead of Intelligence as their main attribute.

entries.name: Dragon Energy
entries.text: Once per turn, your weapon, Taijutsu and Bukijutsu damage ignores temporary hit points.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Ryu Martial Artist can make 3 attacks or 1 Dragon Tail.

entries.name: Punch
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d6 + 3) damage of one elemental type.

entries.name: Kick
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6 + 3) damage of one elemental type.

entries.name: Dragon Tail
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (5d6 + 6) damage of one elemental type. On a hit, the target must make a Strength saving throw vs. DC 18 or be knocked prone (Recharge 6).

notes: The metadata line names no affiliation. The printed average damage figures for Punch, Kick and Dragon Tail do not match their dice; kept as printed.
